page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-standard-32-lssd is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the c4d server family. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs and 124.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 3.88 GB per vCPU. The instance includes local NVMe SSD storage and contains zero GPUs. Network configuration does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With a balanced resource allocation of approximately 4 GB of RAM per dedicated vCPU, this instance class targets workloads requiring consistent CPU performance alongside local NVMe SSD storage. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures that compute resources are not shared with other tenants, mitigating noisy-neighbor issues. This hardware profile is suitable for general-purpose applications, web serving, containerized microservices, and database workloads that benefit from low-latency local NVMe storage.
